title: Control flow
explain: `if` and `else` choose a path, `for` and `while` repeat work, and `switch` picks between many cases. Modern `switch` expressions with `->` return a value and don't fall through. Use `break` and `continue` to leave a loop early or skip an iteration.
exercise: Print the numbers 1 to 20 and write `even` or `odd` next to each one, using a switch expression.
tip: The old `switch` statement falls through to the next case unless you write `break`. Prefer the arrow form, which doesn't.
